scope: MEAS: independently recomputed gates, published bar-map, provenance and all 18 final-candidate pitch-energy overlays; not aural review.

report.finding: The completed per-piece report matches the final gates, source, order, pitch-decay boundary and corrected sheet. It records the rejected pickup mapping and detector limitations. Both initial findings are resolved; the audio score is byte-identical across the sheet repair.

barMap.finding: All 3123 published notes have valid voice/bar indices and positive duration; performed bar times strictly increase. All five SVGs and index.json have exactly bars 1–257. Real opening glyphs are tagged 1 at negative pickup positions; the real final D4 glyphs are tagged 257 with a 9.04-unit box. First and last pages were visually inspected. The listening module uses seconds rather than structured bar anchors.

overlays.finding: No gross audio pitch/order mismatch identified in the inspected overlays, including the quiet major section and final D4. The final written hold ends at a documented pitched-decay display boundary, not a measured bow release.

version.finding: Complete solo-violin Chaconne only, with a two-quarter bar 1 and bars 2–257 once. Major at 133, minor return at 209 and closing-theme return at 249 are written out. Four explicitly encoded source variables are not four continuously independent performed voices. Written arpeggio chords are not represented as measured performance arpeggiations; no additional repeat or arrangement is inferred.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the BGA edition is the symbolic source, not claimed as Heifetz’s performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The provisional label and disclosed quiet-region detector limitations must remain.
